title: Heterometallic CeIV/VV Oxo Clusters with Adjustable Catalytic Reactivities

synthesis.procedure: Stock aqueous solutions of 0.5 M cerium ammonium nitrate, 1 M tetrabutylammonium chloride, 1 M sulfuric acid, and 0.5 M VCl3 were prepared. In a 1.5-dram vial, 0.6 mL of 1 M H2SO4 was added to 0.3 mL of 0.5 M Ce(NH4)2(NO3)6, followed by 0.1 mL of 0.5 M VCl3, 20 μL of 1 M TBACl, and 1 mL deionized water. The mixture was heated at 80 °C without stirring in a heating block for 4–6 h, then left at room temperature to give a crystalline yellow powder. The main text describes assembly of Ce(NH4)2(NO3)6 and VCl3 with sulfonic/sulfuric acid in water under strongly acidic conditions (pH < 1). Single crystals were obtained by the same procedure using 0.8 mL rather than 0.6 mL of the H2SO4 solution.

reagents.name: sulfuric acid
reagents.amount: 0.6 mL of 1 M aqueous solution (0.8 mL for single crystals)

synthesis.time: 4–6 h at 80 °C, then standing at room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 1.5-dram vial in a heating block, unstirred aqueous assembly
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystalline yellow powder after cooling to room temperature. Single crystals from the same recipe with 0.8 mL of 1 M H2SO4.

properties.summary: Solid-state UV–vis spectroscopy shows strong absorption in the UV region, extending to 506 nm for Ce12V6-SO4, shorter than the organic-capped analogues. No luminescence or magnetic data are reported for this cluster.

synthesis.procedure: Stock aqueous solutions of 0.5 M cerium ammonium nitrate, 1 M TBACl, 1 M toluenesulfonic acid, and 0.5 M VCl3 were prepared. To 0.3 mL of 0.5 M Ce(NH4)2(NO3)6 and 0.1 mL of 0.5 M VCl3 in a 1.5-dram vial were added 1 mL of 1 M TsOH, 1 mL water, and 20 μL of 1 M TBACl, in that order. The mixture was heated at 80 °C for 1–2 h and then left at room temperature to give a crystalline yellow powder. In situ crystals from the mother liquor matched Ce12V6-SO4 because of C–S cleavage under the oxidizing, pH < 1 conditions. Recrystallization used 10 mg of powder dissolved in 4 mL DMF/DME (1:3 v/v) with diethyl ether vapor diffusion.

reagents.name: N,N-dimethylformamide
reagents.amount: part of 4 mL DMF/DME (1:3 v/v) for 10 mg powder

synthesis.temperature: 80 °C for powder; room temperature for recrystallization
synthesis.time: 1–2 h heating; crystals in 2 days by vapor diffusion
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 1.5-dram vial, heating block; diethyl ether vapor diffusion into DMF/DME
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystalline yellow powder after standing at room temperature. Large octahedral single crystals (~100 μm) from uncapped 1.5-dram vial of the DMF/DME solution inside an 8-dram vial containing 2 mL diethyl ether, diffusion at room temperature for 2 days. The solved crystal is a DMF-coordinated Ce12V6 sulfate core shared with the NBSA recrystallization; organic sulfonates were not fully resolved.

properties.summary: Solid-state UV–vis spectroscopy shows strong UV absorption extending to 552 nm, broader than Ce12V6-SO4 (506 nm), attributed to the coordinated organic ligands. No luminescence or magnetic measurements are reported.

synthesis.procedure: Aqueous solutions of 0.5 M cerium ammonium nitrate, 1 M TBACl, 0.5 M 4-nitrobenzenesulfonic acid, and 0.5 M VCl3 were prepared. To 0.3 mL of 0.5 M Ce(NH4)2(NO3)6 and 0.1 mL of 0.5 M VCl3 in a 1.5-dram vial was added 1 mL of 0.5 M NBSA. The mixture was left at room temperature for 2–3 days and the crystalline yellow powder was collected by centrifugation. The main text notes a modified protocol relative to the sulfate cluster and C–S cleavage under the Ce(IV), pH < 1 conditions if crystals are grown in situ. Recrystallization used 10 mg of powder in 4 mL DMF/DME (1:3 v/v) with diethyl ether vapor diffusion.

reagents.name: N,N-dimethylformamide
reagents.amount: part of 4 mL DMF/DME (1:3 v/v) for 10 mg powder

synthesis.time: 2–3 days for the powder; 2 days for vapor-diffusion crystals
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 1.5-dram vial at room temperature; diethyl ether vapor diffusion into DMF/DME
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystalline yellow powder isolated by centrifugation. Single crystals by dissolving 10 mg in 4 mL DMF/DME (1:3 v/v) and diffusing 2 mL diethyl ether at room temperature for 2 days. SCXRD of the recrystallized OTs and NBSA materials is the same cubic Fm-3m DMF-coordinated Ce12V6 phase; the nitrobenzenesulfonate ligands were not directly resolved.

properties.summary: Solid-state UV–vis spectroscopy shows strong UV absorption extending to 540 nm, broader than Ce12V6-SO4 (506 nm) and slightly shorter than Ce12V6-OTs (552 nm). No luminescence or magnetic measurements are reported.
